title: Rūpataṇhāsuttaṃ
text: 309 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . ‘‘Rūpataṇhā, bhikkhave, aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī; saddataṇhā… gandhataṇhā… rasataṇhā… phoṭṭhabbataṇhā… dhammataṇhā aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī . Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati ‘saddhānusārī…pe… sambodhiparāyano’’’ti. Aṭṭhamaṃ.
